Title: Public sector education benefits substantially from AKU-IED's programmes: Dr Hamida Khuhro

content.text: Sindh Minister for Education and Literacy Dr Hamida Khuhro has lauded the role of Aga Khan University-Institute for Education Development in the implementation of educational reforms in Sindh and has said that the public sector had substantially benefited from AKU-IED's programmes for improving the quality of education in the province. She was addressing the graduation ceremony for the AKU-IED's Advanced Diploma Programmes on Saturday, January 21, 2006 at AKU Auditorium in Karachi.

The Minister acknowledged the Institute's assistance to the Education and Literacy Department, Government of Sindh in institutional capacity building and mentioned that 646 Government school teachers had benefited from various AKU-IED's programmes. "I am also pleased to note that the AKU-IED has developed 28 M.Ed. graduates, 48 diploma graduates from Leadership and Management programmes, and 33 diploma graduates in curriculum areas for the Government of Sindh," she added.

She felicitated the graduating candidates and said that "I trust that you have broadened your vision and perspective as pedagogical leaders and will continue to work on enhancing the quality of education and transforming your schools into 'Centres of Excellence'."

Later she presented diplomas to thirteen candidates of Advanced Diplomas in Education: Educational Leadership and Management which is a programme aiming to enable head teachers to lead schools effectively. Eighteen candidates received the Advanced Diploma in Education: Primary Education which seeks to develop teacher mentors and leaders through experiences drawn from their own environment.

Earlier, AKU President Shamsh Kassim-Lakha H.I., S.I. welcomed the chief guest while the Institute's Director Dr Muhammad Memon presented introductory remarks. The ceremony ended with refreshments after the valedictorian speech. Key stakeholders from private, public and Aga Khan Development Network (AKDN) school systems also attended the occasion.
